statement.name: GetNavigationItems
statement.sql:
declare @outPut xml select @outPut=( Select [NVGNItemId] as "@Id" ,[MarkupId] as "@MarkupId" ,[DisplayValue] as "@Text" ,REPLACE(isnull(cp.RelativeURL,'#'),'{0}',isnull(convert(varchar(MAX),esdv.[DimensionValue]),'')) as "@Destination" ,pni.[Description] as "@ToolTip" ,[ParentNVGNItemId] as "@ParentNavigationItemId" ,[DisplayOrder] as "@DisplaySequence" ,dbo.ufnPFM_NVGN_GetChildNavigationItems([NVGNItemId]) FROM PFM_NVGN_Item pni Left Outer Join PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage cp on pni.COREPreDefinedPageId=cp.COREPreDefinedPageId left outer join [ExternalSystemDimensionValue] esdv on cp.[ExternalSystemCode]= esdv.[ExternalSystemCode] and cp.[ExternalSystemDimensionCode]= esdv.[ExternalSystemDimensionCode]
where [ParentNVGNItemId] is null
where [ParentNVGNItemId] = (select top 1 NVGNItemId from PFM_NVGN_Item where MarkUpId = )
and [DisplayOrder]!=-1 and ItemTypeCode = order by [DisplayOrder] FOR XML PATH('NavigationItemModel'), TYPE , ROOT('ChildNavigationItems')) if (@outPut is null) set @outPut='<NavigationItemModel></NavigationItemModel>'; else set @outPut='<NavigationItemModel>'+convert(varchar(max),@outPut)+'</NavigationItemModel>' select @outPut

statement.name: GetNavigationItems_New
statement.sql:
declare @outPut xml select @outPut=( Select [NVGNItemId] as "@Id" ,[NVGNItemId] as "@rootNVGNItemIdId" ,pni.ItemTypeCode as "@itemTypeCode" ,[MarkupId] as "@markupId" ,[DisplayValue] as "@displayValue" ,REPLACE(isnull(cp.RelativeURL,'#'),'{0}',isnull(convert(varchar(MAX),esdv.[DimensionValue]),'')) as "@destination" ,pni.[Description] as "@description" ,[ParentNVGNItemId] as "@ParentID" ,[DisplayOrder] as "@DisplaySequence" ,[PopUp] as "@PopUP" ,dbo.ufnPFM_NVGN_GetChildNavigationItems_New([NVGNItemId], 2) FROM PFM_NVGN_Item pni Left Outer Join PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage cp on pni.COREPreDefinedPageId=cp.COREPreDefinedPageId left outer join [ExternalSystemDimensionValue] esdv on cp.[ExternalSystemCode]= esdv.[ExternalSystemCode] and cp.[ExternalSystemDimensionCode]= esdv.[ExternalSystemDimensionCode] where 1=1
and [ParentNVGNItemId] is null
and [ParentNVGNItemId] = (select top 1 NVGNItemId from PFM_NVGN_Item ppni where ppni.MarkUpId = and (ppni.UserTypeCode = or ppni.UserTypeCode = 0))
and [DisplayOrder]!=-1 and (pni.UserTypeCode = or pni.UserTypeCode = 0) order by [DisplayOrder] FOR XML PATH('navigation'), TYPE ) if (@outPut is null) set @outPut='<NavigationItemEntity></NavigationItemEntity>'; else set @outPut='<NavigationItemEntity>'+convert(varchar(max),@outPut)+'</NavigationItemEntity>' select @outPut

statement.name: GetConfigurationLevelNavigationDestination
statement.sql: SELECT TOP 1 REPLACE(,'{0}',convert(varchar(MAX),[ExternalSystemDimensionValue].[DimensionValue])) as Destination FROM ExternalSystemDimensionValue

statement.name: GetResourcesItems
statement.sql:
SELECT convert(nvarchar(36), cs.NVGNContentGroupId) RootNVGNItemIdId, convert(nvarchar(36), cs.NVGNContentSectionId) ParentNavigationItemId, cs.DisplayValue ParentText, CASE WHEN ci.ContentItemCOREPreDefinedPageId IS NOT NULL THEN isnull(replace(convert(VARCHAR(MAX), esdv.DimensionValue) + rtrim(ltrim(pcpdp.RelativeURL)), '{0}', ''),'#') ELSE ci.NavigationURL END AS Destination, ci.DisplayValue Text, convert(nvarchar(36), ci.NVGNContentItemId) Id, ci.CssClass Class, ci.IsPopUp, ci.Description PopUpTitle
FROM PFM_NVGN_ContentItem ci JOIN Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_ContentSection cics ON cics.NVGNContentItemId = ci.NVGNContentItemId JOIN PFM_NVGN_ContentSection cs ON cs.NVGNContentSectionId = cics.NVGNContentSectionId JOIN Rel_PFM_NVGN_ContentItem_PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup cicg ON cicg.NVGNContentItemId = ci.NVGNContentItemId JOIN PFM_NVGN_ContentGroup cg ON cicg.NVGNContentGroupId = cg.NVGNContentGroupId and cg.NVGNContentGroupId = cs.NVGNContentGroupId
left outer join PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage pcpdp on pcpdp.COREPreDefinedPageId = ci.ContentItemCOREPreDefinedPageId left OUTER JOIN ExternalSystemDimensionValue esdv ON pcpdp.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = esdv.ExternalSystemDimensionCode AND pcpdp.ExternalSystemCode = esdv.ExternalSystemCode
order by cs.DisplayOrder,ci.DisplayOrder
